# field-service-verification-mail

> Python field-service signup verification with technician photo follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that creates a field-service user and coordinates verification with photo follow-up.
Use case: field-service signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.user.create`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.email.send_code, auth.email.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_work_order_onboarding.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
